vacancies.title: MultiTrack — новый формат найма для опытных бэкендеров
vacancies.description:
В течение 2–3 месяцев вы сможете поработать в трёх командах Яндекса и выбрать ту, в которой захотите остаться. Ждём опытных разработчиков на Java, Python, Go или C++.

От небольшого стартапа до известного сервиса: посмотрите, как работают в разных командах Яндекса.

Мы запускаем MultiTrack — новый формат найма для опытных бэкендеров. Программа длится 2–3 месяца: за это время мы предлагаем поработать в трёх командах Яндекса, познакомиться с нашими разработчиками и технологиями.

Вот как это выглядит:

* Вы проходите собеседования, заключаете трудовой договор.
* Среди всех открытых вакансий выбираете 3 самых интересных вам команды.
* В первой команде мы предлагаем поработать 4 недели, в остальных — по 3 недели.
* По итогам работы вы сможете обменяться с командами фидбэком и решите, где хотите остаться.

Поможем найти своё

MultiTrack позволит погрузиться в несколько непохожих проектов, увидеть их изнутри и только после этого решить, какой из них подходит именно вам. Творческая свобода? Чёткая иерархия, порядок и регламенты? Только опытным путём можно узнать, какая рабочая атмосфера поможет вашему таланту раскрыться.

Познакомим с сотрудниками

Во время MultiTrack вы сможете познакомиться с разными сотрудниками Яндекса: от коллег и смежников до технических руководителей, найти единомышленников и влиться в команду, которая подходит вам по духу.

Покажем наши технологии

Наши команды используют самые разные технологии: от передовых нейросетевых трансформеров до старого доброго C++. Вы сможете попробовать свои силы в разных направлениях и разрабатывать то, к чему лежит сердце.

Вот что говорят о MultiTrack сами разработчики:

* «Это отличный способ поиска подходящей команды, потому что за час финального интервью невозможно понять особенности команды и проекта, а за 2 недели можно. Лучше узнал, как устроен Яндекс»
* «Очень понравилась сама идея, встречи с техлидами команд, заинтересованность в тебе как в кандидате, хорошая информативность»
* «Понравилось работать в нескольких командах, прежде чем выбрать постоянное место. Это помогло актуализировать мои ожидания и сматчить их с реальностью»
* «Считаю, что такую программу надо предлагать всем и сразу. Знаю, не всем предлагают такую возможность. Мне повезло )) Возможность сравнить практики и подходы работы — это супер»
* «Была возможность попробовать поработать в разных команд (все по разному работают) Выбрать команду по душе — это круто!»

Подробнее о Multitrack

Требования:
* Уверенно владеете Java, Python, Go или C++
* Разрабатывали коммерческие приложения не менее 7 лет
* Поддерживали программное обеспечение от написания до выкладки в продакшен
* Качественно тестируете свой код и свободно работаете с чужим
* Умеете мониторить работу готового ПО и оперативно реагировать на проблемы
* Занимались многопоточным программированием
* Разбираетесь в классических алгоритмах и структурах данных
* Обладаете широким техническим кругозором

Будет плюсом:
* Проектировали архитектуру и разрабатывали продуктовые фичи
* Занимались разработкой для Unix/Linux и сетевым программированием
* Понимаете основы TCP/IP и HTTP
* Понимаете принципы работы СУБД

vacancies.title: Старший бэкенд-разработчик сервисов IAM в команду Yandex Cloud Security
vacancies.description:
IAM (Identity & Access Management) — один из ключевых сервисов Yandex Cloud, отвечающий за аутентификацию, авторизацию и многие другие задачи. Мы ищем опытного разработчика в core-команду IAM. Вам предстоит заниматься широким кругом задач, связанных с авторизацией и аутентификацией.

IAM (Identity & Access Management) — один из ключевых сервисов Yandex Cloud, отвечающий за аутентификацию, авторизацию и многие другие задачи.

Мы ищем опытного разработчика в core-команду IAM. Вам предстоит заниматься широким кругом задач, связанных с авторизацией и аутентификацией. Вашей выделенной зоной ответственности будет развитие клиентов к сервису авторизации, которые используются во многих сервисах Yandex Cloud и Яндекса. Потребуется писать расширяемый код под потребности самых разных сервисов.

Подробнее о нашем подразделении читайте на странице команды Yandex Cloud Security.

Обязанности:
Развитие системы авторизации

Это ключевой продуктовый челлендж. Предстоит работать над гибкими ABAC-like ACL, консистентной авторизацией, а также развивать авторизацию как сервис.

Технические челленджи

В вашу зону ответственности будет входить построение и развитие control-plane для гибкой системы авторизации. Потребуются навыки проектирования модульного сервиса для control-plane.

Стабильность сервисов IAM

Вы будете отвечать за управление нагрузкой в одном из самых нагруженных сервисов Yandex Cloud, внедрение различных стратегий кеширования и широкий спектр задач оптимизации.

Развитие продукта IAM в зоне ответственности core-команды

Вам предстоит расширять функциональность авторизации, развивать движок управления политиками, создавать для пользователей Yandex Cloud новые инструменты анализа уязвимостей.

Больше о том, что под капотом платформы Yandex Cloud, — в канале Inside Yandex Cloud

Требования:
* Хорошо знаете Java, готовы изучать Go
* Строили и поддерживали отказоустойчивые системы
* Работали с реляционными или нереляционными хранилищами
* Ответственно относитесь к документации, качеству и читаемости кода

Будет плюсом:
* Знаете Go

vacancies.title: Тимлид ML-команды (AI Search) в ML-сервисы Yandex Cloud
vacancies.description:
Вы возглавите ML-команду и будете отвечать за разработку базовых технологий для AI-сервисов Yandex Cloud. Наш фокус — создание мультитенантных поисковых и классификационных моделей. Ждём, что вы разрабатывали и выводили в прод ML-сервисы с высокими требованиями к надёжности и производительности.

Мы ищем опытного и проактивного лида, который возглавит ML-команду и будет отвечать за разработку базовых технологий для AI-сервисов Yandex Cloud. Основной фокус команды — создание мультитенантных поисковых и классификационных моделей и компонентов сервисов, которые предоставляются облачным пользователям как:
* Standalone API (например, Embeddings API, Classification API)
* Интегрированные функции в рамках OpenAI-like Responses и RealTime API (реализация RAG-сценариев, memory)
* Технологическая основа для конечных продуктов (AI Guardrails, SpeechSense)

Роль предполагает совмещение технического руководства и организационного управления небольшой распределённой командой, проектирование ML-систем, а также непосредственное участие в разработке.

Мы предлагаем:
* Прямое влияние на core-технологии AI-платформы Yandex Cloud
* Высокий уровень технической автономии и свободу в выборе инструментов (активное использование и развитие опенсорса)
* Возможность выстроить процессы и культуру в новой команде практически с нуля
* Сильную R&D-команду и работу в кросс-функциональных v-teams над технически сложными и интересными задачами

Обязанности:
Команда

Вы будете управлять командой ML-разработчиков: проводить performance review, встречи 1-to-1, ставить цели, помогать разработчикам с карьерным развитием, наращивать знания и опыт команды. Понадобится декомпозировать продуктовые цели и превращать их в технический roadmap, формировать квартальные планы команды и отвечать за их реалистичность и стабильную сходимость. Разрабатывать и внедрять CI/CD для моделей, процессов код-ревью, тестирования и релизного цикла ML-артефактов. Представлять R&D-команды в рамках v-team, обеспечивать видимость и прозрачность деятельности R&D-команды, формировать технические требования и запросы к смежным командам (например, требования к данным и инфраструктуре).

Разработка

Вы станете отвечать за исследование и разработку SOTA-моделей для сценариев RAG (поиск, ранжирование), классификации (few-shot/zero-shot, guards) и памяти, а также их интеграцию в инфраструктуру инференса. Нас вас будет лежать прямая ответственность за метрики качества моделей, а также за производительность и стабильность бэкендов инференса (в том числе за логирование, мониторинги и покрытие кода тестами). Кроме того, вам предстоит лично участвовать в разработке: писать код (до 30¬–40% времени), проводить код-ревью, помогать с архитектурой и диагностикой проблем, готовить релизы моделей и бэкендов.

Больше о том, что под капотом платформы Yandex Cloud, — в канале Inside Yandex Cloud

Требования:
* Управляли ML-командой от одного года
* Глубоко разбираетесь в современном ML (нейросети, трансформеры) с фокусом на NLP, Information Retrieval или Generative AI
* Разрабатывали и выводили в продакшен ML-сервисы с высокими требованиями к надёжности и производительности
* Уверенно владеете Python и PyTorch
* Понимаете полный жизненный цикл ML-модели: от сбора требований и подготовки данных до эксплуатации в проде
* Проактивны и способны самостоятельно формировать технический бэклог и roadmap, исходя из продуктовых целей

Будет плюсом:
* Использовали опенсорс-проекты и контрибьютили в них (особенно в библиотеки для инференса, такие как TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang)
* Работали с C++ и низкоуровневыми оптимизациями (CUDA)
* Работали в распределенной команде
* Умеете или хотите выступать на публике, писать технические статьи или вести блог, чтобы повышать внешнюю видимость команды и продукта

vacancies.title: Разработчик на C++ в команду SEO‑платформы
vacancies.description:
Мы разрабатываем SEO‑платформу для нескольких продуктов Яндекса. Ищем бэкенд-разработчика, которому будет интересно работать на всех этапах — от создания модели данных и API до интеграции в продукт и эксплуатации. Ждём, что вы занимались коммерческой разработкой, уверенно владеете C++ и STL.

Наша команда разрабатывает SEO‑платформу для нескольких продуктов Яндекса. Мы создаём и обновляем миллионы посадочных страниц под поисковые запросы, удаляем дубли URL, настраиваем редиректы и перелинковку, готовим данные для поисковых роботов. Также мы разрабатываем серверную логику на C и пайплайны подготовки данных.

Сейчас мы преобразуем решения одного продукта в общую платформу: подключаем новые продукты, переносим данные в распределённое хранилище и оптимизируем межсервисные запросы.

Ищем бэкендера, которому будет интересно работать на всех этапах — от создания модели данных и API до интеграции в продукт и эксплуатации.

Обязанности:
Развитие C++-сервисов SEO-платформы

Вы будете разрабатывать серверную логику: заниматься редиректами, перелинковкой и выдачей SEO‑данных, подключать к платформе новые продукты. Вам предстоит проектировать API, согласовывать контракты между сервисами и вносить сквозные изменения — от хранилища до продуктового бэкенда. Также нужно будет оптимизировать сетевые запросы, кеширование и время ответа.

Автоматизация пайплайнов

Вы будете автоматизировать создание и обновление посадочных страниц, генерировать sitemap и готовить данные для онлайн‑сервисов. Вам предстоит работать с большими объёмами данных и распределённым хранилищем, внедрять проверки качества перед публикацией, настраивать мониторинг свежести данных и обеспечивать безопасный откат изменений.

Больше о бэкенде в Яндексе — в канале Yandex for Backend

Требования:
* Работали в коммерческой разработке
* Уверенно владеете C++ и STL, знаете алгоритмы и структуры данных
* Умеете проектировать бэкенд‑сервисы
* Разделяете ответственность компонентов
* Проводите изменения в нескольких связанных системах
* Понимаете принципы межсервисного взаимодействия: HTTP, RPC, сериализацию данных, таймауты, обработку ошибок и совместимость API‑контрактов
* Находите узкие места и оптимизируете производительность с помощью пакетной обработки, дедупликации, кеширования и сокращения сетевых запросов, продумываете безопасное внедрение и откат изменений
* Пишете модульные и интеграционные тесты, используете метрики и логи для диагностики
* Готовы разбираться в существующем коде
* Взаимодействуете со смежными командами при реализации сквозных задач

Будет плюсом:
* Занимались многопоточным и сетевым программированием
* Разрабатывали высоконагруженные сервисы
* Работали с распределёнными хранилищами, шардированием и миграциями данных
* Создавали пайплайны обработки и публикации больших объёмов данных
* Знакомы с Python и SQL
* Разрабатывали общие платформенные компоненты для нескольких продуктов — с изоляцией данных, отдельными конфигурациями и независимым внедрением изменений
* Использовали AI‑инструменты для исследования кода, разработки, тестирования и рефакторинга, проверяли результат тестами, статическим анализом и код‑ревью

vacancies.title: Руководитель группы разработки CI в Автономном транспорте
vacancies.description:
Мы создаём технологию автономного управления автомобилем. Приходите развивать инструменты сборки и тестирования кода, автоматизацию ручной работы, проектировать и реализовывать компоненты платформы разработки. Ждём, что вы готовы писать на Python и работать на стыке технологий.

Автономный транспорт — это сотни разработчиков, тысячи пул-реквестов в день и десятки часов проверок. Чтобы машина надёжно доехала из точки А в точку Б, каждый коммит должен пройти через систему непрерывной интеграции, а каждый релиз — через многоэтапную приёмку.

Команда непрерывной интеграции автономного транспорта отвечает за этот конвейер: от PR-проверок до релизного пайплайна. Мы ищем руководителя, который возьмёт на себя управление командой и вместе с нами превратит CI в быстрый, прозрачный и отказоустойчивый сервис.

Обязанности:
Руководство командой непрерывной интеграции

Вы будете управлять командой разработки, выстраивать регулярные процессы — стендапы, планирование, ретроспективы — и распределять задачи по ключевым направлениям. Ждём, что вы сможете совмещать техническую экспертизу с управленческой: погружаться в архитектуру CI-пайплайнов и одновременно растить людей, помогать им развиваться и доводить решения до production-качества.

Развитие релизной машины и приёмки релизов

Вам предстоит развивать главный конвейер автономного транспорта — релизный пайплайн: от сборки релизного кандидата до многоэтапной приёмки. Каждый релиз должен проходить через формализованные процедуры верификации, а критерии приёмки — быть измеримыми и воспроизводимыми. Ваша задача — автоматизировать этот процесс так, чтобы он оставался строгим, но не тормозил разработку.

Стабильность, скорость и AI-инструменты

Вы будете отвечать за скорость и надёжность CI-пайплайнов: отслеживать узкие места, работать с командами-потребителями над устранением блокеров, внедрять мониторинг и SLA. Мы активно развиваем AI-помощников для автоматизации рутинных операций — от диагностики падений до помощи дежурным. Вам предстоит довести эти инструменты до промышленной эксплуатации и расширить на новые сценарии.

Больше о бэкенде в Яндексе — в канале Yandex for Backend

Требования:
* Руководили технической командой от 2 лет
* Понимаете устройство CI/CD в больших монорепозиториях: системы сборки, распределённые проверки, релизные графы
* Уверенно владеете Python, знакомы с C++ или Go
* Умеете выстраивать процессы и доводить сервисы до production-качества

Будет плюсом:
* Работали в областях, смежных с CI/CD: статический анализ, qualification toolchain, функциональная безопасность
* Работали с CI/CD в регулируемых отраслях (автомотив, авиация, медицина)
* Участвовали в масштабировании CI/CD на команды 100+ разработчиков

vacancies.title: Старший разработчик на Go в Смену
vacancies.description:
Яндекс Смена — главный стартап Райдтеха, который является миллиардным бизнесом и не останавливается на достигнутом. Мы в поиске бэкенд-разработчиков.

Мы создаём Яндекс Смену — сервис, который помогает людям находить удобную подработку рядом с домом. Каждый день через нас выходят на работу тысячи людей — а вы можете повлиять на то, как устроен этот процесс изнутри. У нас есть две стороны: миллионы пользователей, которые ищут подработку с гарантией выплат и нормальными условиями, и крупные партнёры («Пятёрочка», «Перекрёсток», «Магнит» и другие), которым важно надёжно и просто находить исполнителей.

Яндекс Смена — главный стартап Райдтеха, который является миллиардным бизнесом и не останавливается на достигнутом. Мы объединяем плюсы стартапа и большой технологической компании:

* Низкий параметр time-to-market, который в сочетании с продуктовым подходом позволяет быстро и динамично делать крутые фичи и проекты.

Больше о бэкенде в Яндексе — в канале Yandex for Backend

В течение трёх месяцев вы поработаете в трёх разных командах подразделения: 4 недели в одной, по 3 недели ещё в двух. Узнайте про разработку городских сервисов Яндекса на dev.go.yandex

Команда выбора

vacancies.title: Senior Product Manager, Compute Strategy and Planning

As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).

Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.

Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

Co-build with Customer Engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.

Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.

Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch for customers.

Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g. Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).

Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers.

Preferred qualifications:
Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).

Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

vacancies.title: Formal Verification Engineer, Google Cloud

Experience working with one or more formal verification tools, such as JasperGold, VC Formal, Questa Formal, or 360-DV.

vacancies.title: ML Innovation for Products, PhD Research Intern
vacancies.description:
The ML Innovation for Products (MLIP) team is an applied machine learning and research team within Meta's Ranking & Foundational AI org, focused on the state-of-the-art (SOTA) 0-to-1 ML that powers retrieval, ranking, and auction across Meta's ads systems. This is a very unique team that functions like an applied research lab with a production deploy button: we imagine, evaluate, prototype, and ship 10x ideas into one of the largest recommender systems in the world, a system that serves billion-scale users every single day and is the engine behind Meta's revenue. As a horizontal team, we have the unique leverage to develop SOTA techniques alongside expert engineers and researchers, then scale them into the head models powering Facebook, Instagram, and beyond.
What you would work on
Because the team works at the boundary of research and production, our research and its applications are intertwined, and much of the work is published at major ML and recommender systems conferences. Some of the work the team is involved in includes:
Memora, a new scaling paradigm for ads recommendation inspired by memory research in LLMs. Learned representations in large recommenders turn out to be highly concentrated, so much of the input signal is effectively ignored and further architectural scaling yields flattening returns. We build memory modules that store and retrieve historical model-generated representations and inject them back as differentiating signals, improving model quality without proportionally scaling compute. Two workstreams: Learning from Memory (LFM) and Enriched Ad Sequences (EAS).  
Graph Learning at billion-node scale. We build heterogeneous graph representations of users, ads, and their interactions, including user journey graphs, and we push the modeling frontier: k-hop induced subgraph methods, temporal GNNs, graph transformers, and deeper architectures with residual and spectral rewiring to counter over-smoothing and over-squashing. A parallel track turns this into a self-serve platform so that experiment throughput, not infrastructure, is the bottleneck.  
LLM and Multimodal Fusion. Ad-side and user-side content understanding are both crowded research areas, but almost no one combines them with graph-structured relational signals. That gap is the opening. Our SELF workstream, for Semantic-Engagement LLM Fusion, contrastively trains ad and user encoders so that engagement structure from the interaction graph and semantic content from multimodal LLMs land in one shared embedding space that retrieval can search directly.  
Agentic AI. We are building a shared agentic layer that abstracts planning, tool orchestration, memory, and execution into reusable services. The flagship is IDEA, which has already taken techniques from paper to validated production model improvements end to end, with domain overlays that specialize it for memory, sequences, graph learning, retrieval policies, and foundation models. The research questions it raises about autonomous experimentation are wide open.  
Reinforcement Learning. Large parts of the ads retrieval flow are still tuned by hand: how many candidates to keep at each stage, how to mix retrieval routes, where to set recall cutoffs. These decisions have no clean ground-truth label to supervise against, which is exactly the gap RL is built to close. We replace static global constants with per-request policies learned from logged traffic that optimize the realized system outcome directly rather than a low-fidelity offline proxy. Our first production policy personalizes a retrieval keep ratio per request on Facebook Mobile Feed. The longer-term direction is joint multi-knob optimization across the flow on one shared reward and off-policy evaluation foundation.

Who we are:
We are a team of 15 ML engineers and research scientists spanning Sunnyvale and the Bay Area, supported by senior technical leads with deep experience taking research from idea to production. We partner closely with product groups across Meta, so the surface area available to an intern is much wider than any single pod. The team values knowledge sharing and continuous learning, and runs regular technical deep dives and AI best-practice workshops alongside a buddy system for onboarding.

Responsibilities:
Conduct state-of-the-art research to advance the science and technology of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. Develop novel algorithms and corresponding systems, leveraging various AI and ML techniques including LLMs and agentic pipelines. Analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of corresponding deployed algorithms. Collaborate with researchers and engineers across varied disciplines, including communicating research plans, progress, and results. Publish research results and contribute to research that can be applied to Meta product development.

Qualifications:
Currently has or is in the process of obtaining a Ph.D. degree in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Information or Multimedia Retrieval, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Reinforcement Learning, Optimization, Computational Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related technical fields Must obtain work authorization in the country of employment at the time of hire and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment Experience with deep learning frameworks such as Pytorch or Tensorflow Experience with Python, C++, C, Java, or other related languages Experience with research and building systems based on machine learning and/or deep learning methods Intent to return to degree program after the completion of the internship/co-op Proven track record of achieving significant research results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as first-authored publications at leading workshops or conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, KDD, IJCAI, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, NAACL, ICASSP, or similar Demonstrated software engineer experience via an internship, work experience, coding competitions, or widely used contributions in open source repositories (e.g. GitHub) Demonstrated experience and self-driven motivation in solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches Experience manipulating and analyzing complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from varying sources for large-scale training Experience working and communicating cross functionally in a team environment

Depending on audit outcomes, we may take a variety of actions; everything from implementing management action plans, which set requirements for remediation of identified risks and control gaps, to working with cross-functional teams to implement systems and/or engineering fixes, which ensure that the backend infrastructure is operating as intended. As a Research Engineer on our AI team, you will work at the intersection of applied AI research and production engineering, implementing and scaling novel machine learning systems that translate cutting-edge research into real-world impact. In this role, you will collaborate closely with research scientists to develop, evaluate, and deploy AI models across Meta's family of products, contributing to breakthroughs in areas such as large language models, generative AI, computer vision, and recommendation systems.

-------

Meta repousse les frontières de l’intelligence artificielle pour alimenter des produits et des expériences utilisés par des milliards de personnes à l’échelle mondiale. En tant qu’ingénieur de recherche au sein de notre équipe d’IA, vous travaillerez à l’intersection de la recherche appliquée en IA et de l’ingénierie de production, en mettant en œuvre et en déployant à grande échelle de nouveaux systèmes d’apprentissage automatique qui transforment la recherche de pointe en retombées concrètes. Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous collaborerez étroitement avec des chercheurs pour développer, évaluer et déployer des modèles d’IA au sein de la famille de produits de Meta, contribuant ainsi à des percées dans des domaines tels que les grands modèles de langage, l’IA générative, la vision par ordinateur et les systèmes de recommandation.

vacancies.title: People Service Delivery Lead
vacancies.description:
The People Service Delivery (PSD) team's mission is to run a high-performing, people-focused service delivery organization. Leading with care and empathy, we develop efficient processes, systems, and programs. We aim to ensure employees feel heard and have the resources and support they need during the most important moments so they can do impactful work.

The People Service Delivery Lead sits at the intersection of people operations domain expertise and hands-on engineering. This role owns large-scale transformation programs end to end, and, unlike a traditional program role, also contributes to designing and building the solutions those programs depend on. This lead reads HR, payroll, and people-operations workflows fluently, identifies where the seams and inefficiencies are, and then helps architect tooling solutions that close them.

Working closely with leaders across People Operations, executive sponsors, engineering, and other key XFN stakeholders, this lead challenges assumptions and the status quo to improve processes, reduce barriers, and mitigate risks. Much of the work is greenfield: problems arrive without a playbook, and this lead defines the path as they walk it. This person does not need to have the “correct” answer to everything. What matters is the ability to quickly drive the conversation toward a productive solution by bringing together the right people, process, and technology, including building a working prototype when that is the fastest way to create clarity.

A key expectation of this role is to be an active driver of AI adoption and creative problem-solving in operations. This lead looks for opportunities to responsibly use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve consistency, accelerate resolution times, and enhance the employee experience while ensuring strong governance, quality, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.

Responsibilities:
Own development, organization, and execution of large, complex business and operational programs from inception through delivery, with little to no oversight; own the program roadmap and scoping, making tradeoffs to optimize time-to-release and clearly communicating goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes. Deliver tooling that removes manual effort from people operations workflows. Partner with Engineering to shape system design and technical direction, translating people operations needs into clear requirements. Participate in design and solution reviews, holding a high-quality bar for what the team ships. Deconstruct end-to-end employee lifecycle journeys (from hire through movement, leave, and exit) to identify seams, handoff failure points, and automation opportunities across teams and systems, then build the solutions that address them. Drive AI-enabled operational improvement, including identifying use cases for automation, workflow optimization, knowledge management, and case deflection, balancing efficiency with employee care and quality outcomes. Improve efficiency and quality of systems and operations through end-to-end process frameworks and optimization initiatives, and design the change management that drives adoption of new processes, systems, or tooling, including training and communication plans for all levels, locations, and XFN partners. Partner with HR Tech, engineering teams, and vendors to identify, build, and implement appropriate technology solutions; oversee system integration efforts and ensure smooth transition and adoption. Identify, escalate, and mitigate program risk proactively rather than reactively. Move fluidly between audiences (SMEs, payroll leadership, engineering peers, and skip-level leadership), simplifying complex technical concepts for non-technical groups without losing precision, and maintaining open, candid, and trusting working relationships. Monitor stabilization of changes to ensure processes and systems are executed per design.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, operations, HR, consulting or related fields 8+ years of experience in managing large-scale, global transformation or continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving business processes, systems, and operations, with demonstrable business results Domain knowledge of HR, payroll, or people-operations processes, or demonstrated experience in ramping quickly into a complex operational domain Experience designing or operating HR processes spanning multiple stages of the employee lifecycle (e.g., hire/onboarding, movement, leaves and time away, compensation and payroll events, and offboarding), with an understanding of how upstream decisions create downstream operational load Experience operating independently through ambiguity on greenfield problems, navigating competing and shifting priorities to maintain momentum, and delivering results in a detail-oriented, highly organized manner Experience problem-solving using data, translating thorough examination and analysis into action Experience working in an XFN environment: building relationships, consensus building, and motivating teams at all levels, technical and non-technical, to get colleagues on board with the benefits of transformational change Knowledge and understanding of the tech and software industry's business models and core processes Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Experience in understanding and facilitating change in a dynamic environment: handling challenges and pushback from senior stakeholders Experience in requirement analysis techniques and methodologies, and delivering business value through process improvement in a high-tech operations space Comfortable working in a modern web stack (TypeScript, React) environment and able to hold substantive technical conversations with engineering partners

$145,000/year to $205,000/year

vacancies.title: Marketing Manager, Wearables (APAC)
vacancies.description:

This is a leadership role and will drive category narrative, launch experience, and sustained growth by partnering closely with Product Marketing, Retail, Sales/Partnerships, Communications and external agencies. The role will also own business health, tracking sales, leading indicators on brand health and performance, identifying risks, and escalating critical mitigations and decision asks to leadership.

Set APAC strategy for category leadership: Define multi-quarter market strategy (audiences, channel roles, investment priorities) and build culturally resonant narratives and use cases for APAC region Own Go-To-Market & launch leadership: Lead end-to-end GTM for launches and peak moments—planning, readiness, messaging alignment, cross-functional governance, and post-launch learning Creative ownership (strategy → execution): Establish creative strategy and messaging hierarchy; write strong briefs; lead creative development with external agencies/production partners; ensure high creative craft and effectiveness across channels Media ownership (planning → optimization): Own APAC media strategy and budget allocation across the funnel; partner with media agency/internal teams to plan, launch, measure, and optimize against KPIs (including experimentation/test-and-learn) Retail & partner amplification: Lead cross-functional collaboration with Retail to drive in-store experience (demo strategy, merchandising, training inputs, retail events, retail measurement). Qualifications:
15+ years of experience in integrated marketing, Go-To-Market, product/category marketing, or brand/performance marketing (consumer tech/devices/retail) Proven ownership of market-level strategy and execution in APAC markets Demonstrated ownership of media strategy and budget with performance management and optimization Proven experience with creative strategy/briefing skills and a track record of leading creative and media agencies to deliver high-quality outcomes Proven cross-functional leadership through influence (Product Marketing Manager/Product, Retail, Sales/Partnerships, Communications, Analytics) Experience with executive communication and stakeholder management and experience in driving decisions in ambiguous situations Experience with incrementality/brand lift testing and mixed-method measurement Experience with APAC retail programs (in-store demos, merchandising, promoter training, retail events) Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Experience marketing hardware/devices (smart glasses, wearables, smartphones) Experience leading partner GTM with major accounts (marketplaces, large-format retail, specialty, operators) and co-marketing governance Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

vacancies.title: Research Scientist PhD Intern, Summer 2027
vacancies.description:
Research happens across Google everyday, in many different teams. Our research has already impacted user-facing services across Google including Search, Maps, and Google Now, and is central to the success of Google Cloud and our computing, storage, and networking infrastructure.
Research Interns work with Research Scientists and Software Engineers to discover, invent, and build at scale. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, Research Interns work on challenges in artificial intelligence, machine perception, data mining, machine learning, natural language understanding, privacy, computer architecture, networking, operating systems, storage and data management, and more. You are also expected to contribute to the wider research community by publishing papers.
Team Specifications: 
Google’s Core Organization builds the foundational systems, technical frameworks, and platforms that power Google products worldwide. Within Core, our overarching mission is simple yet profound: to make Google work better for everyone at scale. Within Core, the Privacy, Safety, and Security (PSS) organization is dedicated to keeping everyone safe at scale—protecting billions of users, safeguarding their data, and securing Alphabet and the broader internet ecosystem. We operate on the principle that products must be secure by default and private by design.

Our research teams bridge the gap between theoretical computer science and planetary-scale engineering. We bring together researchers and engineers across cryptography, adversarial machine learning, privacy-preserving computation, systems security, and trustworthy AI. As a Research Scientist in Core PSS, you will pursue foundational and applied scientific breakthroughs—investigating emergent threat vectors, developing next-generation privacy and safety primitives, and creating mathematical and empirical guarantees that redefine digital safety. You will collaborate closely with core engineering hubs to translate novel proofs-of-concept into production deployments safeguarding billions of global users, while maintaining active contributions to the scientific community through first-tier publications, open-source initiatives, and academic partnershipsGoogle is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities:
Participate in research to develop solutions for problems.

Research, conceive, and develop AI/ML solutions to accelerate.

Contribute to deeper understanding of limitations of AI/ML architectures, trade-offs and optimizations.

Lay down the next steps for adoption of the research into next generation product development.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science and Engineering, Machine Intelligence and Data Science, AI or a related technical field. 

Experience in one or more areas of Machine Learning (e.g., Large Language Models, Deep Learning, Natural Language, Computer Vision, etc.).

Experience programming in Python, Java.

Preferred qualifications:
Currently enrolled in a full-time degree program and returning to the program after completion of the internship.

Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.

Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in conferences or journals.

Experience with one or more of AI/ML frameworks.

Experience with security-related research, systems, or technologies.

Ability to design and execute on research agendas.

vacancies.title: Senior Software Engineer, Search Quality
vacancies.description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Web Health team's mission is to build user trust by ensuring Google shows a helpful mix of websites across all Search traffic. We achieve this by owning the full ML lifecycle, from developing state-of-the-art models to deploying them directly across Web Ranking and GenAI surfaces.

We are looking for an ML engineer with a deep care for and understanding of the intricate interplay between data, algorithms, objectives and business impact. 
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities:
Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.

Collect, analyze and visualize data from various sources to formulate and test hypotheses.

Design and implement ML systems from training data composition to hyperparameter tuning to post-deployment monitoring and optimizations.

Understand and build upon latest technologies such as Gemini foundational models using distillation and fine-tuning.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

5 years of experience with software development in C++ or Python.

3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

3 years of experience specializing in a machine learning field (e.g., foundational models, ML infrastructure, reinforcement learning, or similar areas).

3 years of experience with end-to-end machine learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

Preferred qualifications:
PhD (or industry research experience) in ML, AI or related technical fields.

Experience in full-cycle development and productionization of machine learning systems.

Experience in distilling and deploying production-grade LLMs.

Experience programming in Kotlin.

vacancies.title: Data and AI Engineer

We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. 

As a Senior Software Engineer for the IPU Storage Offloads team, you will design and implement the low-level software and firmware that powers Google’s next-generation Infrastructure Processing Unit (IPU). You will focus on the Persistent Disk (PD) data path, enabling high-performance NVMe emulation, hardware compression/decompression, and hardware-accelerated cryptography. 

You will bridge the gap between ASIC capabilities and core block-storage services to deliver unprecedented Input/Output Operations per Second (IOPS) and latency metrics while guaranteeing end-to-end data integrity and confidentiality.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Optimize the data-path for microsecond-level latency and millions of IOPS using advanced hardware features like physical doorbells and direct cache routing.

Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

5 years of software development experience in C or C++ with a focus on systems programming.

Experience with low-level systems architecture: PCIe, DMA, IOMMU, memory-mapped I/O (MMIO), and interrupt handling.

Experience debugging on pre-silicon or early bring-up platforms using hardware emulators (e.g., P3, CSS models) or physical logic analyzers/JTAG.

vacancies.title: Research Scientist Intern - Neural Representations Compression
vacancies.description:
In the rapidly evolving fields of AI, Augmented Reality (AR), and Virtual Reality (VR), industry compression research is shifting from human-consumed media to non-human-consumed internal neural model states. These representations include latent tensors, weights, Gaussian splats, feature maps, and depth/alpha buffers exchanged between neural networks. As high-capability models exceed on-device compute limits while cloud execution is constrained by latency, privacy, and power, systems are adopting split inference—partitioning model execution between devices and datacenters connected by neural bitstreams. In this architecture, the compression ratio on the split link serves as a primary determinant of round-trip latency, bandwidth efficiency, and battery performance.

Advancing compression techniques for neural representations expands beyond rendering outputs to critical non-media data streams. Key emergent areas include Feature Coding for Machines (FCM) for intermediate network features, visual and multimodal token pruning/compression, low-latency action and control streams for embodied systems, KV cache compression for distributed LLM prefill and decode stages, model deltas for on-device personalization, and persistent scene state streams for interactive world models. Establishing specialized compression capabilities across these representations directly impacts the operating efficiency and scalability of split-inference AI and XR applications.

The intern will explore several key directions in compression and streaming techniques for neural representations:
1. Latent Vector Compression: Developing efficient quantization, entropy coding, and learned prior models for compact, high-dimensional latent spaces exchanged in split-inference architectures.
2. Gaussian Splat Compression: Creating specialized compression and streaming algorithms that maintain the spatial distribution, opacity, and color parameters of 3D Gaussian splats with high rendering fidelity and low memory footprint.

Throughout the project, the intern will conduct a thorough review of existing literature, implement prototype models, and benchmark them against traditional compression methods. The final goal is to develop a neural compression framework that outperforms current techniques in terms of compression ratio, speed, and fidelity.

This research not only contributes to the academic field but also has direct applications in improving the operational efficiency of AR/VR systems, ultimately pushing the boundaries of what is possible in digital interaction spaces.

Responsibilities:
Explore issues involved in processing, compressing and streaming neural and/or learned representations. Identify, with assistance of the mentor(s), opportunities for significantly improving compression efficiency and/or quality. Work with peers to build a working prototype of the proposed algorithm. Communicate ongoing research progress and final results.

Qualifications:
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a PhD degree in the field of Image and Video Processing, Signal Processing, Information Theory, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics, or related field Coding experience in C/C++ and/or Python Experience in image and video processing Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as first-authored publications at leading workshops or conferences such as ICIP, DCC (Data Compression Conference), CVPR, IEEE Transactions or Letters, ACM SIGGRAPH, etc Intent to return to a degree-program after the completion of the internship/co-op Knowledgeable about applications related to neural networks and compression Knowledgeable about existing image and video codec standards (H.26x, VPx, JPEG, etc) Knowledgeable about existing Point Cloud compression standards (MPEG PCC) Knowledgeable about Learning-based compression

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As a part of the Discover Personalization team, you will help people feel positively connected and informed about the world around them by delivering the pulse of the Internet that matters to you, within Google Search. You will contribute to the key product's appeal, which lies in having an understanding of users and will be laser focused on building foundational user models for users using all of their interactions across Google products, and leveraging them to power Discover’s retrieval and ranking. You will manage some of the toughest ML and Quality problems, including Neural Deep Retrieval, Activity Clustering, Reinforcement Learning and Multi-Objective Ranking.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Design and implement personalized user models to optimize for user happiness, including Neural Deep Retrieval Models, Deep Neural Network Ranking/Scoring models, User/Content Clustering Models, Large Language Models (LLM)-based Retrieval Augmented Generation Models, and more.

Build user and content clustering models to enable core personalization and ranking use cases.

Enhance model performance and personalization precision/recall through advanced modeling techniques such as transformers, distillation, reward shaping, multi-task learning, neural bandits, etc. and capabilities through feature engineering, automatic parameter tuning, label quality engineering, etc.

Scale the model's applications to a multitude of modalities (content, queries, videos and notifications) and use cases (retrieval, ranking, content generation, diversification, etc.).

Create next-generation realtime ML models that can capture new user interests and world trends in seconds and scale model training and serving to billions of users.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

8 years of experience in software development.

5 years of experience building and deploying recommendation systems models (retrieval, prediction, ranking, embedding) in production and experience building architecture in different modeling domains.

5 years of experience with ML design and ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).

5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:
8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

6 years of ML or Quality experience working on recommendation systems.

Experience in recommender systems, clustering algorithms, SQL, deep model.

Experience in C++, Dremel/F1 and TensorFlow.

Experience working with research.

Ability to drive quality projects end-to-end from design to implementation to eventual launch.

vacancies.title: Silicon Design Manager, RTL Machine Learning, Accelerator Design
vacancies.description:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of  Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.
As a Silicon Design Manager, you will develop high-performance and low-power hardware to enable continuous innovations in the Tensor Processing Unit (TPUs). In this role, you will work with Architects to drive architectural feasibility, establish timing design goals, and explore trade-offs for physical design closure. You will also work with Software teams to understand and implement clocking and power management requirements.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

vacancies.title: Staff Research Software Engineer, Google Research
vacancies.description:
Google Research Singapore is the very latest addition to the Google Research presence around the globe. This is an incredible opportunity to be advancing the frontier of AI capabilities in Singapore. The team delivers research on algorithmic efficiency, and inference acceleration, directly impacting how next-generation AI models will be deployed to billions of people.
In this role, you will sit at the heart of advancing fundamental capabilities of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive significant benefits to humanity. You will have the chance to help build a team from the ground up. You will be pioneering AI research in Singapore, focusing on enabling the most performant, ultra-efficient and capable Generative AI Models. You will be making pioneering breakthroughs towards Computational Efficiency for serving and deployment of large-scale Generative AI Models (e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs), Diffusion Models, Generative Videos). You will be a technical leader of a small and agile team, in an extremely fast-paced environment in close collaboration with other teams at Google.

Design and implement novel algorithms that optimize the inference stack for LLMs to ensure the highest througput and lowest latency for billions of users including sampling techniques, speculative decoding advancements, model compression, knowledge distillation and quantization strategies.

Work on development and optimization of the low-level software that runs AI models efficiently. Implement and optimize custom kernels for inference, focusing on improving latency, throughput, and memory usage, across different hardware and model architectures.

Co-design algorithms that exploit the unique architectectural advantages of custom hardware and accelerators. Collaborate with hardware architects on next-generation systems and use a deep understanding of both model architecture and hardware to inform algorithm selection.

Amplify impact and influence the research ecosystem through publications and scientific dissemination.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

8 years of experience in software development.

5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

5 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

5 years of experience with ML design and ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).

Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:
PhD in Machine Learning, AI, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical field.

Experience in a university or industry labs, with primary emphasis on AI research.

Deep understanding of transformer architecture internals.

Deep understanding of Machine Learning (ML) systems, distributed systems, compilers, or performance engineering. Experience in high-performance computing, or AI inference optimization and hands-on experience with low-level compute frameworks.

vacancies.title: Senior Research Scientist, Graph Neural Network
vacancies.description:
As a Research Scientist on the Graph Neural Network (GNN) team within OMEGA, you will pioneer research at the intersection of deep learning, structured data, and Large Language Models (LLMs). In this role, you will invent novel neural architectures, graph encoders, and agentic retrieval methods that bring relational reasoning to foundation models at massive scale. You will collaborate closely with partners across Google Research, Google DeepMind, and core product teams to translate theoretical breakthroughs into production-grade frameworks and next-generation AI capabilities.

As a part of the Graph Neural Network (GNN) team, you will bridge relational structure and deep learning, making it seamless to integrate graph-structured data into neural networks and foundation models at massive scale. As a part of the team, you will conduct fundamental research and build production-grade frameworks to train and deploy these models over complex, heterogeneous graphs. Recently, the team's work has expanded into generative AI, developing structured data encoders, graph tokens, hybrid graph-sequence architectures, and graph-based retrieval and agentic systems to enhance Large Language Models (LLMs).
Google Research is building the next-generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.
As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

In this role, you will conduct research on multimodal LLM and agentic workflows for generative media. Collaborating closely with visual generation researchers, you will focus primarily on the language and reasoning side of multimodal generation and multi-turn editing—designing and post-training models that understand nuanced user intent, ground generation using search and external tools, evaluate output quality via reward models and automated judges, and generalize across various languages and writing systems.
Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Responsibilities:
Conduct fundamental and applied research on multimodal LLMs and agentic workflows for generative media, including multi-turn reasoning, planning, instruction following, and tool use.

Design, prototype, and run experiments on post-training and alignment methods (such as fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and synthetic data curation) to improve model quality, faithfulness, and controllability.

Define data pipelines, benchmarks, reward models, and evaluation metrics for multimodal generation and interactive editing under minimal guidance, refining hypotheses through empirical analysis.

Identify and investigate research opportunities in multilingual, cross-lingual, and cross-script multimodal modeling, collaborating with internal teams to shape research strategy and expand impact.

Author research papers to share findings in the research community, and partner with Engineering teams to transfer promising research into Google products.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience with research projects in Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Multimodal Machine Learning.

One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:
2 years of coding experience.

1 year of experience owning and initiating research agendas.

Research experience or publications in LLM agents (planning, reasoning, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation), multimodal vision-language models, multilingual NLP, or post-training and alignment (fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, reward modeling).

vacancies.title: Research Scientist, Robotics Data, Pretraining, DeepMind
vacancies.description:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.
As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Our mission is to combine Gemini foundation models with physical intelligence so general-purpose robots can understand and act reliably in the real world. Our team's research develops data quality insights on how to best extract physical and action knowledge from robot-related datasets, and incorporates these insights into Gemini pre-training through model training and upstreaming. By pairing data ablations with fast closed-loop robot evaluations, you will shape how physical reasoning and action capabilities emerge in next-generation Gemini models and deploy onto real-world robots.

At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. vacancies.description:

You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of  Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, for High-Speed DSP, you will architect and define the low-level firmware and control loops powering Google's physical-layer communications silicon. Sitting at the critical intersection of digital signal processing (DSP), hardware-software co-design, and real-time systems, you will lead the development of adaptive algorithms, error correction (FEC), and link-telemetry frameworks. Your work will directly bridge the gap between high-performance hardware pipelines and Google’s AI infrastructure, transforming complex communication systems theory into reliable, real-time silicon execution.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities:
Define the long-term firmware roadmap and hardware-software partitioning for physical-layer interfaces, determining the optimal balance between hardware-fixed logic and programmable firmware.

Architect advanced "in-situ" monitoring systems and firmware-driven diagnostics to track physical-layer link health, Bit Error Rate (BER) trends, and channel quality across millions of ports in real-time.

Design, model, and implement bare-metal or RTOS firmware to control high-speed transceivers, managing real-time adaptive loops, clock and data recovery (CDR), and physical-layer calibration.

Partner with TPU Systems, Networking Software, and High-Performance Computing (HPC) teams to ensure silicon firmware integrates seamlessly with global cluster management and collective communication frameworks.

Identify and de-risk hardware-software interface bottlenecks (e.g., register maps, driver latencies, and boot-up sequencing) that impact Google's AI infrastructure.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

10 years of industry experience in embedded systems/firmware, communication systems engineering, or digital signal processing (DSP) development.

Experience developing embedded software (C/C++) for high-speed physical-layer interfaces (PHY), digital transceivers, or communication subsystems.

Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Expertise in Forward Error Correction (FEC) algorithms and advanced modulation schemes.

Track record defining firmware framework specifications, register maps, and Silicon Life-cycle Management telemetry for high-volume networking or AI silicon.

Background in wireless communications with deep domain knowledge of channel modeling, noise mitigation, and digital transceiver architectures.

vacancies.description:

As a Senior Security Engineer on the Agentic Red Team, you will be the primary technical executor of adversarial engagements. You will work with product builders, identifying architectural flaws during the design phase long before formal reviews begin.

Your core focus will be to perform multi-turn attacks on production-level AI models, specifically targeting agentic behaviors like tool usage and reasoning chains. You will not only find vulnerabilities but also help close the loop by contributing to Auto Red teaming frameworks and defensive strategies, ensuring that your findings are codified into reusable guardrails for all Google agent developers.
Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. vacancies.title: Senior Product Manager, Eval Quality, AI Data
vacancies.description:
Artificial Intelligence is evolving at an unprecedented pace, and AI Agents represent the next frontier. These agents, capable of complex reasoning, tool use, and interacting with dynamic environments, are poised to redefine how we live and work. Ensuring these agents are safe, reliable, and effective is paramount, and that's where evaluations come in.
Evaluations have always been the bedrock of successful AI development. However, the methods used for traditional Large Language Models fall short when it comes to agents. Unlike static models, agents operate in a world of vast possibilities, delivering value through a sequence of actions and interactions.

We need to pioneer new ways of thinking for agent evaluation. Think Waymo online: we must create rich, dynamic simulation environments to test agents against a massive state space, uncovering failure modes and ensuring robust performance across countless scenarios. This isn't just an incremental improvement; it's about defining how the next generation of AI will be validated.

If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and solving some of the most problems in the field, this is your chance. With over a billion people using the service and more than fifty offices around the globe, a career at Meta offers countless ways to make an impact in a fast growing organization.

Meta is seeking Research Interns to join our Search AI teams within Facebook. Facebook Search helps people find the people, groups, events, videos and posts they are looking for, across one of the largest and fastest-changing content collections in the world. Our teams build AI that helps people decide what to search for and find useful results. This spans personalized query suggestions before and during a search, suggested queries on Reels, and retrieval and ranking of relevant content. We bring together generative AI, multimodal understanding, and personalization to help people express intent, act on curiosity, and discover useful content at Facebook scale. Our interns will have the opportunity to frame practical, high-impact search problems as rigorous machine learning problems, and bring their own expertise to build innovative solutions under the guidance of our research scientists and software engineers.

The central research challenge is to connect what a person wants to explore with content that makes the journey worthwhile. For example, a video can spark curiosity before someone has a query in mind; the system must suggest a useful question and deliver results that reward that curiosity. Models must understand explicit queries or infer interests from multimodal content, generate useful suggestions or retrieve relevant results, and balance engagement with relevance, groundedness, and factuality within strict latency and compute constraints. Open problems include generative retrieval using learned identifiers that represent content, personalized query generation, sequence models for ranking individual results and composing a useful results page, and joint learning across suggestions and results. LLM-based supervision, post-training, and online experiments help us connect model improvements to useful exploration and sustained search habits.

If you are excited about helping billions of people turn curiosity into useful discovery, from the first search suggestion to the results that follow, come join us!

Our internships are twelve (12) to sixteen (16), or twenty-four (24) weeks long and we have various start dates throughout the year.
